evidence_kinds.host_execution: test-ce-cdda-vram at 1ac6f424: the CD music reader with the production music transport, 164,233 checks without and 211,893 with the transfers (231,328 at beeef062, before both video-memory views were checked whole); five passes over three piece shapes with music pending (as accepted, below the emergency PIO floor, chained token searches, faults, urgent music). Authored card, drive and video-memory models; the G1 bus, PVR timing and the music worker's CE thread are not modelled.
evidence_kinds.static_review: CE's exception vectors, identical in Virtua Cop 2's, Armada's and 4x4 Evolution's kernels, take TLB misses on banked registers and move to CE's kernel stack for other exceptions at thread level; only a nested exception builds a frame of about 320 bytes on the current stack. Every GD call site in the kernel is in wsegacd.dll, in thread context.

limits: wsegacd aborts a request after 15 s without a drive interrupt (GD ABORT), and the reader's ABORT raises no interrupt. The 512 KiB piece is estimated to take seconds; the console test asks for the time.
The hook and ISR guard literals are not pinned by a linked audit; they come from the same macro as the stack, which the reader's marker and linker script tie together.
Other piece shapes (an ordinary DMAREAD into video memory, the TA path) stay refused.
The other CD music modules keep the refusal.
